p='programs/task-d5d28abd.py'
s=open(p).read(); start=s.index('def transform')
s='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    color=next(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0,1))
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==color]
    r0,r1=min(r for r,c in cells),max(r for r,c in cells)
    c0,c1=min(c for r,c in cells),max(c for r,c in cells)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        if grid[r][c]!=1: continue
        if r0<=r<=r1 and (c<c0 or c>c1):
          for j in range(w):
            if j!=c and grid[r][j]==0: out[r][j]=color
        if c0<=c<=c1 and (r<r0 or r>r1):
          for i in range(h):
            if i!=r and grid[i][c]==0: out[i][c]=color
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
